# SQLite WASM 3.54.1

Unmodified `dist/index.mjs` and `dist/sqlite3.wasm` from npm package
`@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm@3.54.1-build1`. Studio loads these only for MKW-ZIP
operations inside a worker. The runtime opens an in-memory database.
Licensing terms for the SQLite and Emscripten portions appear in the header
of `index.mjs`.

- [Upstream package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/v/3.54.1-build1)
- [SQLite copyright](https://sqlite.org/copyright.html)
